usageNote: make the journey是正式说法，日常可直接说go to school by car，两个意思一样，但前者更书面一点！

examples.en: Many parents make the journey to school by car every morning.
examples.zh: 很多家长每天早上开车送孩子上学。

examples.en: She decided to make the journey to school by car because it was raining heavily.
examples.zh: 因为大雨，她决定开车去学校。
